title: SANTA eval-tier actuals
description: A runner's output for one vector: an object mapping each entry's `name` to the runner's own { value, cost, error }. Normative companion to docs/contract/runner-contract.md §3-5. SValue/SType definitions are reused from the vector schema by $ref.

result.description: One entry's actual outcome. Success: value (SValue) + cost (number) + error null. Failure: value null + cost null + error 'errored'. Same shape as a vector's expected.

cost.description: Raw JIT eval cost as a bare JSON number (NOT a string). Null iff errored.

error.description: Coarse outcome flag: null on success, 'errored' on any failure.

allOf.$comment: errored => value and cost null; success => error null, cost present, value non-null.
